thyroid_centroid.name: Thyroid centroid
thyroid_centroid.derived: volume centroid of the baked 'thyroid' mesh

thyroid_right_lobe_upper_pole.name: Upper pole of the right lobe
thyroid_right_lobe_upper_pole.derived: baked 'thyroid' vertex with the largest y among vertices on the patient's right of the part's bounding-box midline (x < -0.45)

thyroid_left_lobe_upper_pole.name: Upper pole of the left lobe
thyroid_left_lobe_upper_pole.derived: baked 'thyroid' vertex with the largest y among vertices on the patient's left of the part's bounding-box midline (x > -0.45)

thyroid_right_lobe_lower_pole.name: Lower pole of the right lobe
thyroid_right_lobe_lower_pole.derived: baked 'thyroid' vertex with the smallest y among vertices on the patient's right of the part's bounding-box midline (x < -0.45)

thyroid_left_lobe_lower_pole.name: Lower pole of the left lobe
thyroid_left_lobe_lower_pole.derived: baked 'thyroid' vertex with the smallest y among vertices on the patient's left of the part's bounding-box midline (x > -0.45)
